description.sk: Jemné krémové kari s kuracím mäsom, mletými kešu orieškami, jogurtom a kardamónom.
description.en: A mild creamy curry with chicken, ground cashews, yogurt and cardamom.

steps.sk: Kešu zalej 150 ml horúcej vody a nechaj 15 minút namočiť, potom ich rozmixuj aj s vodou na hladkú pastu. Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky a premiešaj s jogurtom, kurkumou a polovicou soli.
steps.en: Cover the cashews with 150 ml of hot water and soak for 15 minutes, then blend them with the water into a smooth paste. Cut the chicken into pieces and mix with the yogurt, turmeric and half the salt.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a na masle ju opekaj na miernom ohni 10 minút, kým nie je mäkká a zlatá – nie hnedá, korma má zostať svetlá. Pridaj nastrúhaný zázvor a cesnak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and cook them gently in the butter for 10 minutes until soft and golden, not brown; a korma should stay pale. Add the grated ginger and garlic and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj garam masalu a kardamón, krátko premiešaj a pridaj mäso aj s jogurtom. Dus 10 minút za občasného miešania, kým mäso nezbelie.
steps.en: Add the garam masala and cardamom, stir briefly and add the chicken with its yogurt. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the meat turns white.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj kešu pastu, smotanu, zvyšnú soľ a 150 ml vody a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a omáčka hustá a krémová. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Stir in the cashew paste, cream, remaining salt and 150 ml of water and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce thick and creamy. Meanwhile cook the rice.

steps.sk: Podávaj s basmati ryžou alebo naanom. Korma vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; pri ohrievaní prilej lyžicu vody.
steps.en: Serve with basmati rice or naan. The korma keeps in the fridge for 3 days; add a spoonful of water when reheating.

description.sk: Pálivé goanské kari z bravčového mäsa marinovaného v octe, cesnaku a čili.
description.en: A fiery Goan curry of pork marinated in vinegar, garlic and chilli.

steps.sk: Cesnak, zázvor, čili, papriku, rascu, škoricu, klinčeky, ocot a polovicu soli rozmixuj na hustú pastu. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm, obaľ ho v korenistej zmesi a nechaj marinovať aspoň 1 hodinu.
steps.en: Blend the garlic, ginger, chilli, paprika, cumin, cinnamon, cloves, vinegar and half the salt into a thick paste. Cut the pork into roughly 3 cm cubes, coat in the paste and marinate for at least 1 hour.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a opekaj ju na oleji na strednom ohni 12 minút, kým nie je tmavozlatá. Pridaj pretlak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly into half-moons and fry them in the oil over a medium heat for 12 minutes until deep golden. Add the tomato paste and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso aj s marinádou a opekaj 5 minút. Zalej 300 ml vody, pridaj cukor a zvyšnú soľ, prikry a dus na miernom ohni 75 až 90 minút, kým mäso nie je veľmi mäkké a omáčka hustá.
steps.en: Add the meat and marinade and fry for 5 minutes. Pour in 300 ml of water, add the sugar and remaining salt, cover and braise over a low heat for 75 to 90 minutes until the pork is very tender and the sauce thick.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj – vindaloo má byť pálivé a jemne kyslé; pre jemnejšiu verziu použi menej čili. Podávaj s ryžou a jogurtom, ktorý pálivosť zmierni. Na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Taste: vindaloo should be hot and slightly sour; for a milder version use less chilli. Serve with rice and yogurt, which tames the heat. It tastes even better the next day.

description.sk: Vegánske kari zo zemiakov a špenátu s rascou, zázvorom a cesnakom.
description.en: A vegan curry of potatoes and spinach with cumin, ginger and garlic.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm a uvar v osolenej vode 8 minút, kým nie sú takmer mäkké. Sceď ich.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut into roughly 2 cm cubes and boil in salted water for 8 minutes until almost tender. Drain.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici zohrej olej, pridaj rascu a po 30 sekundách nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu. Opekaj 5 minút, potom pridaj nastrúhaný zázvor, cesnak a nasekané čili a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the cumin and after 30 seconds the finely chopped onion. Fry for 5 minutes, then add the grated ginger, garlic and chopped chilli and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj kurkumu, nakrájanú paradajku a zemiaky a opekaj 5 minút, kým zemiaky nezačnú na okrajoch zlatnúť. Potom po hrstiach pridávaj špenát a miešaj, kým nezvädne.
steps.en: Add the turmeric, the chopped tomato and the potatoes and fry for 5 minutes until the potatoes start to colour at the edges. Then add the spinach a handful at a time, stirring until it wilts.

steps.sk: Pridaj garam masalu a soľ a var ešte 3 minúty, kým sa tekutina zo špenátu neodparí a zemiaky nie sú mäkké. Podávaj s chlebom alebo ryžou; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Add the garam masala and salt and cook for 3 more minutes until the spinach liquid has evaporated and the potatoes are tender. Serve with bread or rice; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.en: Sambar: South Indian lentil and vegetable stew

description.sk: Kyslá korenistá vegánska šošovicová polievka so zeleninou, k ryži.
description.en: A tangy spiced vegan lentil stew with vegetables, served with rice.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni a var ju s kurkumou v 1 litri vody 15 minút, kým sa nerozpadá. Medzitým nakrájaj mrkvu na kolieska, baklažán na kocky, fazuľku na kúsky a cibuľu na mesiačiky.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils and simmer them with the turmeric in 1 litre of water for 15 minutes until they fall apart. Meanwhile slice the carrots, dice the aubergine, cut the beans into pieces and the onion into wedges.

steps.sk: K šošovici pridaj zeleninu, nakrájané paradajky, kari, soľ a 300 ml vody a var 15 až 20 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne.
steps.en: Add the vegetables, chopped tomatoes, curry powder, salt and 300 ml of water to the lentils and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

steps.sk: Na malej panvici rozpáľ olej, pridaj rascu a čili a nechaj ich 30 sekúnd zasyčať, kým nezavoňajú. Horúci olej s korením vlej do sambaru – tomu sa hovorí tadka a dodá hlbokú vôňu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a small pan, add the cumin and chilli and let them sizzle for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour the hot spiced oil into the sambar; this is called a tadka and gives a deep aroma.

steps.sk: Dochuť citrónovou šťavou – sambar má byť jemne kyslý. Posyp koriandrom a podávaj s ryžou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Season with lemon juice; sambar should be gently sour. Sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Juhoindická žltá ryža s citrónom, kurkumou, kari korením a chrumkavými arašidmi.
description.en: South Indian yellow rice with lemon, turmeric, curry spices and crunchy peanuts.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a uvar so 450 ml vody a polovicou soli pod pokrievkou na minimálnom ohni 12 minút. Nechaj ju 10 minút odstáť, potom ju rozprestri na plech, aby vychladla a zrnká boli sypké.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 450 ml of water and half the salt, covered, on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Let it stand for 10 minutes, then spread it on a tray so it cools and the grains stay separate.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej panvici zohrej olej, pridaj arašidy a opekaj ich 2 minúty dozlatista. Pridaj rascu, nastrúhaný zázvor a nakrájané čili a opekaj 30 sekúnd.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan, add the peanuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden. Add the cumin, grated ginger and sliced chilli and fry for 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Odstav z ohňa a vmiešaj kurkumu – na horúcom oleji by zhorkla. Pridaj ryžu, zvyšnú soľ a šťavu z citróna a jemne premiešaj, kým nie je ryža rovnomerne žltá.
steps.en: Take off the heat and stir in the turmeric; in very hot oil it turns bitter. Add the rice, the remaining salt and the lemon juice and toss gently until the rice is evenly yellow.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrom a podávaj teplú alebo vlažnú, samotnú s jogurtom alebo ako prílohu ku kari. Hodí sa aj do krabičky.
steps.en: Sprinkle with coriander and serve warm or lukewarm, on its own with yogurt or as a side to curry. It also suits a lunchbox.

description.sk: Vrstvená voňavá ryža so zeleninou, korením a opraženou cibuľou, vegetariánska.
description.en: Layered fragrant rice with vegetables, spices and crisp fried onions.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a namoč na 20 minút. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a opekaj ju na oleji 15 minút, kým nie je tmavozlatá a chrumkavá. Tretinu odlož na posypanie.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and soak for 20 minutes. Slice the onions thinly and fry them in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden and crisp. Set a third aside for topping.

steps.sk: K zvyšnej cibuli pridaj nastrúhaný zázvor a cesnak, garam masalu a kurkumu a minútu opekaj. Pridaj zeleninu nakrájanú na kúsky, jogurt, polovicu soli a 100 ml vody a dus 10 minút, kým zelenina nie je takmer mäkká.
steps.en: Add the grated ginger and garlic, garam masala and turmeric to the remaining onions and fry for a minute. Add the vegetables cut into pieces, the yogurt, half the salt and 100 ml of water and cook for 10 minutes until the vegetables are almost tender.

steps.sk: Ryžu var v 2 litroch osolenej vody so škoricou, kardamónom a bobkovými listami 5 minút – má byť napoly uvarená. Sceď ju.
steps.en: Boil the rice in 2 litres of salted water with the cinnamon, cardamom and bay leaves for 5 minutes; it should be half cooked. Drain.

steps.sk: Na zeleninu v hrnci navrstvi ryžu, posyp natrhanou mätou a odloženou cibuľou. Hrniec pevne prikry (pod pokrievku daj alobal) a var na minimálnom ohni 20 minút – ryža dovarí v pare.
steps.en: Layer the rice over the vegetables in the pot and scatter with torn mint and the reserved onions. Cover tightly (put foil under the lid) and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes; the rice finishes in the steam.

steps.sk: Biryani pri podávaní opatrne premiešaj zospodu, aby sa vrstvy spojili, a podávaj s jogurtom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Gently mix the biryani from the bottom when serving so the layers combine, and serve with yogurt. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.en: Kerala chicken stew in coconut milk

description.sk: Jemné juhoindické kura so zemiakmi, zázvorom a čiernym korením v kokosovom mlieku.
description.en: A mild South Indian chicken stew with potatoes, ginger and black pepper in coconut milk.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky, zemiaky a mrkvu na kocky asi 2 cm, cibuľu na tenké polkolieska, zázvor na tenké prúžky a čili pozdĺžne rozkroj.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into pieces, the potatoes and carrot into roughly 2 cm cubes, the onion into thin half-moons, the ginger into fine strips, and slit the chillies lengthways.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej kokosový olej, pridaj škoricu a klinčeky a po 30 sekundách cibuľu, zázvor, cesnak a čili. Opekaj 5 minút do mäkka, cibuľa nesmie zhnednúť.
steps.en: Heat the coconut oil in a pot, add the cinnamon and cloves and after 30 seconds the onion, ginger, garlic and chillies. Fry for 5 minutes until soft; the onion must not brown.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj 3 minúty, kým nezbelie. Pridaj zemiaky, mrkvu, korenie, soľ, polovicu kokosového mlieka a 200 ml vody a var pod pokrievkou 20 minút, kým zemiaky nezmäknú.
steps.en: Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes until white. Add the potatoes, carrot, black pepper, salt, half the coconut milk and 200 ml of water and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.sk: Vlej zvyšné kokosové mlieko a zohrej, ale už nevar – mlieko by sa zrazilo. Vylov škoricu a klinčeky. Podávaj s ryžou; jedlo je jemné, vhodné aj pre deti.
steps.en: Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and heat through without boiling, or it will split. Fish out the cinnamon and cloves. Serve with rice; the dish is mild and suits children too.

title.en: Aloo matar: potato and pea curry

description.sk: Domáce vegánske kari zo zemiakov a hrášku v paradajkovej omáčke.
description.en: A homestyle vegan curry of potatoes and peas in tomato sauce.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, cesnak a zázvor nastrúhaj.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into roughly 2 cm cubes. Finely chop the onion and grate the garlic and ginger.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej olej, pridaj rascu a po 30 sekundách cibuľu. Opekaj 6 minút do zlatista, potom pridaj cesnak, zázvor a koriander, kurkumu a čili a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot, add the cumin and after 30 seconds the onion. Fry for 6 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, ginger, ground coriander, turmeric and chilli and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky a var 5 minút, kým zmes nezhustne a olej sa na okrajoch neoddelí. Pridaj zemiaky, soľ a 400 ml vody a var pod pokrievkou 15 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until thick and the oil separates at the edges. Add the potatoes, salt and 400 ml of water and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj hrášok a garam masalu a var ešte 5 minút, kým zemiaky nie sú mäkké a hrášok uvarený. Posyp koriandrom a podávaj s ryžou alebo chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Add the peas and garam masala and cook for 5 more minutes until the potatoes are tender and the peas cooked. Sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice or bread. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Losos v pikantnej jogurtovej marináde, upečený pod grilom, s uhorkovou raitou.
description.en: Salmon in a spiced yogurt marinade, grilled, with cucumber raita.

note.sk: 150 g do marinády, 150 g do raity
note.en: 150 g for the marinade, 150 g for the raita

steps.sk: Zmiešaj 150 g jogurtu s garam masalou, paprikou, čili, kurkumou, prelisovaným cesnakom, nastrúhaným zázvorom, šťavou z polovice citróna a polovicou soli. Lososa v marináde obaľ a nechaj 30 minút v chladničke.
steps.en: Mix 150 g of the yogurt with the garam masala, paprika, chilli, turmeric, crushed garlic, grated ginger, the juice of half the lemon and half the salt. Coat the salmon and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Na raitu nastrúhaj uhorku, vytlač z nej vodu a zmiešaj so zvyšným jogurtom, nasekanou mätou a zvyšnou soľou. Ryžu uvar.
steps.en: For the raita grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix with the remaining yogurt, chopped mint and remaining salt. Cook the rice.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 230 °C s grilom. Lososa ulož na plech s papierom kožou nadol a griluj 10 až 12 minút, kým marináda nie je na okrajoch opečená a ryba sa v strede rozdeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 230 °C with the grill on. Lay the salmon skin side down on a lined tray and grill for 10 to 12 minutes until the marinade is charred at the edges and the fish flakes in the centre.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou, raitou a mesiačikmi citróna.
steps.en: Serve with the rice, raita and lemon wedges.

title.sk: Matar pulao – ryža s hráškom a korením
title.en: Matar pulao: spiced rice with peas

description.sk: Voňavá basmati ryža s hráškom, rascou, škoricou a opraženou cibuľou.
description.en: Fragrant basmati rice with peas, cumin, cinnamon and fried onion.

steps.sk: Ryžu preplachuj, kým voda nie je číra, a namoč ju na 20 minút – zrnká budú dlhšie a nebudú sa lámať. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska.
steps.en: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and soak it for 20 minutes; the grains will be longer and will not break. Slice the onion thinly.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo, pridaj rascu, škoricu, klinčeky, bobkové listy a kardamón a 30 sekúnd opekaj. Pridaj cibuľu a opekaj 8 minút, kým nie je zlatohnedá.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pot, add the cumin, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaves and cardamom and fry for 30 seconds. Add the onion and fry for 8 minutes until golden brown.

steps.sk: Pridaj scedenú ryžu a hrášok a minútu opatrne premiešavaj, aby sa ryža obalila maslom. Zalej 550 ml horúcej vody so soľou, priveď do varu, prikry a var na minimálnom ohni 12 minút.
steps.en: Add the drained rice and the peas and stir gently for a minute to coat the rice in butter. Pour in 550 ml of hot water with the salt, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Odstav a nechaj 10 minút odpočívať pod pokrievkou. Prečechraj vidličkou, vylov celé korenie a podávaj ako prílohu ku kari alebo samotné s raitou.
steps.en: Take off the heat and rest, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork, fish out the whole spices and serve as a side to curry or on its own with raita.

description.sk: Chrumkavé kúsky kurčaťa v pikantnej marináde s cesnakom, zázvorom a citrónom.
description.en: Crisp chicken bites in a spicy marinade with garlic, ginger and lemon.

note.sk: toľko vsiakne; na vyprážanie priprav asi 400 ml
note.en: this much is absorbed; have about 400 ml for frying

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky veľkosti sústa. Zmiešaj jogurt, prelisovaný cesnak, nastrúhaný zázvor, čili, papriku, garam masalu, šťavu z polovice citróna a soľ. Mäso v marináde obaľ a nechaj 30 minút v chladničke.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Mix the yogurt, crushed garlic, grated ginger, chilli, paprika, garam masala, the juice of half the lemon and the salt. Coat the chicken and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Tesne pred vyprážaním vmiešaj do mäsa škrob a múku, aby sa na kúskoch vytvoril lepkavý obal. Ak je zmes príliš riedka, pridaj lyžicu škrobu.
steps.en: Just before frying, stir the cornflour and flour into the chicken so a sticky coating forms on each piece. If the mixture is too wet, add a spoonful of cornflour.

steps.sk: V hlbšej panvici rozpáľ olej na 175 °C. Vyprážaj mäso po častiach 4 až 5 minút, kým nie je tmavočervené a chrumkavé a vo vnútri prepečené, bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175 °C. Fry the chicken in batches for 4 to 5 minutes until deep red, crisp and cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.sk: Vyberaj ho na papierovú utierku, pokvapkaj zvyšným citrónom a posyp koriandrom. Podávaj hneď ako predjedlo alebo s ryžou a jogurtom.
steps.en: Drain on kitchen paper, squeeze over the remaining lemon and scatter with coriander. Serve straight away as a starter or with rice and yogurt.

title.sk: Gobi manchurian – karfiol na indočínsky spôsob

description.sk: Chrumkavé ružičky karfiolu v lepkavej sladkokyslej omáčke so sójou, cesnakom a čili.
description.en: Crisp cauliflower florets in a sticky sweet-sour sauce with soy, garlic and chilli.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Karfiol rozober na malé ružičky. Z 3 lyžíc škrobu, múky, čili, soli a asi 120 ml vody vymiešaj husté cesto a ružičky v ňom obaľ.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Break the cauliflower into small florets. Whisk 3 tablespoons of cornflour, the flour, chilli, salt and about 120 ml of water into a thick batter and coat the florets in it.

steps.sk: Ružičky rozlož na plech s papierom, pokvapkaj 3 lyžicami oleja a peč 25 minút, v polovici ich otoč, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a chrumkavé.
steps.en: Spread the florets on a lined tray, drizzle with 3 tablespoons of oil and bake for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown and crisp.

steps.sk: Medzitým na zvyšnom oleji vo woku opeč nasekaný cesnak, zázvor a bielu časť cibuľky 1 minútu na vysokom ohni. Pridaj papriku nakrájanú na štvorce a 2 minúty opekaj.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry the chopped garlic, ginger and white spring onion in the remaining oil in a wok over a high heat for 1 minute. Add the pepper cut into squares and fry for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj sójovú omáčku, kečup, čili omáčku, ocot a 100 ml vody so zvyšným škrobom a var minútu, kým omáčka nezhustne a neleskne sa. Hoď do nej karfiol, rýchlo premiešaj a posyp zelenou cibuľkou.
steps.en: Add the soy sauce, ketchup, chilli sauce, vinegar and 100 ml of water mixed with the remaining cornflour and simmer for a minute until thick and glossy. Toss in the cauliflower, stir quickly and scatter with the green spring onion.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď s ryžou, kým je karfiol ešte chrumkavý – v omáčke rýchlo mäkne.
steps.en: Serve at once with rice while the cauliflower is still crisp; it softens quickly in the sauce.

description.sk: Kuracie mäso v hustej korenistej špenátovej omáčke s cesnakom, zázvorom a jogurtom.
description.en: Chicken in a thick spiced spinach sauce with garlic, ginger and yogurt.

steps.sk: Špenát spar vriacou vodou 1 minútu, sceď a rozmixuj na hladké pyré s trochou vody. Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky.
steps.en: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, drain and blend into a smooth purée with a little water. Cut the chicken into pieces.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej olej, pridaj rascu a po 30 sekundách nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu. Opekaj 8 minút do zlatista, pridaj nastrúhaný zázvor a cesnak, kurkumu, čili a garam masalu a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot, add the cumin and after 30 seconds the finely chopped onions. Fry for 8 minutes until golden, add the grated ginger and garlic, turmeric, chilli and garam masala and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj nakrájanú paradajku a mäso a opekaj 5 minút, kým mäso nezbelie. Odstav a vmiešaj jogurt, potom vráť na mierny oheň.
steps.en: Add the chopped tomato and the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until the meat turns white. Take off the heat and stir in the yogurt, then return to a low heat.

steps.sk: Pridaj špenátové pyré a soľ a dus pod pokrievkou 15 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a prepečené. Ak je omáčka hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Add the spinach purée and salt and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and cooked through. Add a little water if the sauce is too thick.

steps.sk: Podávaj s basmati ryžou alebo naanom. Do krabičiek ideálne, v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Serve with basmati rice or naan. Ideal for lunchboxes, it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Bombajský toast s čili a koriandrom
title.en: Bombay toast with chilli and coriander

description.sk: Slaný indický francúzsky toast s vajcom, cibuľou, čili a koriandrom.
description.en: A savoury Indian French toast with egg, onion, chilli and coriander.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, čili bez semienok a koriander nasekaj veľmi nadrobno. V širokom plytkom tanieri rozšľahaj vajcia s mliekom, kurkumou, garam masalou, soľou a nasekanou zeleninou.
steps.en: Chop the onion, deseeded chilli and coriander very finely. Beat the eggs in a wide shallow dish with the milk, turmeric, garam masala, salt and the chopped vegetables.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpusti trochu masla na strednom ohni. Krajec chleba ponor do vajec z oboch strán – nechaj ho nasiaknuť asi 10 sekúnd – a polož na panvicu. Navrch nalej lyžicu zeleniny z vajec.
steps.en: Melt a little butter in a pan over a medium heat. Dip a slice of bread in the egg on both sides, letting it soak for about 10 seconds, and lay it in the pan. Spoon some of the vegetables from the egg on top.

steps.sk: Peč 2 minúty z každej strany, kým nie je toast zlatohnedý a vajce stuhnuté. Rovnako priprav zvyšné krajce a pred každým pridaj kúsok masla.
steps.en: Fry for 2 minutes per side until golden brown and the egg has set. Cook the remaining slices the same way, adding a little butter before each.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplé s kečupom, ako sa to robí na uliciach Bombaja, alebo s mätovým čatní.
steps.en: Serve warm with ketchup, as on the streets of Mumbai, or with mint chutney.
